label: Session record
description: One session as the guard keeps it between calls, through state.port.json: who it belongs to, the digest of the refresh token that renews it and when that expires, and the attributes the session shape judges.

id.description: the key: the sid an access token and a refresh token carry

refreshHash.description: the digest of the refresh token that renews this session, never the token itself

refreshExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601; past it the session has ended, and the guard ends it on the next read

attributes.description: what the caller carries between calls; the shape settings.session names judges every write, in the plugin
